question_records.source_gold_facets_and_negative_review: Package bin/exports fields directly bind vite, client and module-runner; build config negative does not declare public exports.
Exact four-file ordered mode list and false branch read; client env assignment negative is a distinct runtime phase.
Parsed-prefixed values precede Task getEnvs values, which precede matching process.env assignments; file parse negative alone cannot prove precedence.
Empty prefix throws while whitespace only warns; local-mode rejection is a distinct validation condition.
Adapter freezes a copied hosts array and formats preview/server-specific rejection; import verified as external host-validation-middleware alias.
Additional host list covers server host, websocket host, preview host, and best-effort origin URL with catch; middleware adapter is downstream.
Gold covers stripBase before middleware bypass before 302 root/index redirect with suffix; 404 suggestion branch is separate.
GET/HEAD, favicon, Accept and URI decode guards each occur in the supplied span and return next; base 404 negative lacks them.
URL helper checks instantiateStreaming availability and application/wasm prefix, else uses response.arrayBuffer; file helper uses node fs instead.
Instance glue preserves global imports through instance suffix and wrapper unwraps non-default globals; ?init branch is a distinct API. Mixed claim is glue-level, not a wasm execution result.
Named predicate calls RESERVED_WORDS and VALID_JS_IDENTIFIER; adjacent constant independently read as Unicode identifier regex. Export-name formatter is a caller, not the predicate.
parseWasm catch includes failing path, original message and cause; runtime data URL helper has a different error context.
Public file WeakMap initialization plus cached membership and uncached containment/stat paths fully cover the question; asset plugin only delegates.
JS bootstrap imports dist/node/cli.js and TS build config maps cli to src/node/cli.ts with node output pattern; package bin is supporting evidence. No ordered graph metric is claimed.
loadEnv directly obtains mode files, checks file/FIFO, reads UTF-8 and calls parseEnv; related discovery question remains explicitly same f0002 family.
JSON/JSON5 path regex anchors filename end or query marker; JsonOptions describes output settings instead.
Global object fallback and dotted define assignment are in client env source; loadEnv only builds the server-side dictionary.
Environment plugin resolution handles falsy skip, true original, replacement flattening/filter and ignored-hook warnOnce; sample plugin is not the general resolver.
Raw branch watches and reads UTF-8 then emits a string module with moduleType js; surrounding URL resolution independently read to confirm negative context.
Noninteractive nonempty target defaults overwrite to no and exits through cancel; later package naming cannot authorize removal.

family_review: f0002.en01 and f0002.en02 transparently share one family; no extra independent family for the call-chain view.
Other first20 intents differ in required behavior/evidence; shared files and broad concepts are not by themselves proof of semantic equivalence.
Nineteen labels are a corpus accounting result, not a statistical independence certification.

source_manifest_findings.finding: Blanket MIT(first-party repository source) is inaccurate for all admitted files.
source_manifest_findings.observed_notices: Facebook/Create React App MIT; Rollup MIT text and fixed source link; node-graceful-fs ISC with fixed license link; Preact/WMR MIT text; Larry Bahr MIT; explicit StackOverflow and Node source attributions.
source_manifest_findings.requested_action: Retain original source bytes and notices, record per-file attributed sections/provenance and observed license evidence. Do not claim that every admitted byte is exclusively first-party MIT or impose an invented external handoff gate.
